text: Rescoped 2026-09-22 as the pre-freeze construction audit. Once "[release] Decide the 1.0 stable-type list (stability table) before API-shape work" lists the stable types, apply the Cartesian-product test (AGENTS.md rule 8) to each stable public type and to each type reachable from its public fields/results, including parameterised enum cases. For each one, record: honest product data / unforgeable (non-case, four doors probed from outside the package) / wire-bounded (every boundary validates). Known starting set: Admissibility (bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX), RecallSignature (bd-01M16E05TWX28QKJF2GFY67ZZV), the seven `case class ... private[x]` types (Admissibility, BoundaryScore, AtlasFeatureLayer, NarrativeScene, FeatureObservationPlacement, DraftAbsenceLedger, VoyageScene), and TruncationPolicy.KeepHead/KeepTail(maxTokens). Deliverable: a committed table in docs/ plus a bead for each defect. The 422-case whole-codebase census is explicitly not required. Now blocks the release gate bd-01M2TAMJ95K9D7H248A8387YW4.
